text_block_list.text:
—It happened just as that day's training 
had ended.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer. By the way, regarding 
tomorrow's training—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"—Aah! Suzuka-chan spotted! Bourbon-chan! 
Cute capture mode, go!☆"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Falcon-san. Commencing capture 
operation now.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, wait, Bourbon—

...Silence Suzuka was whisked away by two 
Umamusume in an instant. Hurrying after 
them—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
One, two, smile! Sparkle☆ One, two, pose! 
Strike☆ Now, everyone together~♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
One, two, smile. Sparkle. One, two, pose. 
Strike. —Command execution complete.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... I keep getting invited to dance 
lessons. I just never know how to turn 
them down...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because both Suzuka-chan and Bourbon-chan 
have the makings of an Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Natural talent aside— this lesson is time 
well spent.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san is so adept at expressing her 
emotions; there are many valuable insights 
to learn from her behavior.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do our best, everyone! 
After all, the audience is watching us☆

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You have my thanks. A third-party 
perspective is essential for delivering a 
better performance, after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right on, well said! Alright, cue the 
music~♪

And so, I watched the three of them during 
dance lessons for a while, but—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Next is call-and-response practice with 
everyone! I'll show you how it's done, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, you over there! On my cue, call 
back with 'Fa-l-co!'☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You got dragged into this too, 
Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Right, here we go! Fal-fal-fal-fal~?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"With more energy! 'Fa-lu-co~!' ☆ All 
right, Bourbon-chan, you're next!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Commencing operation. 
—Brrr-shiver-shake~?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Bour-booon!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, flawless♪ That's Suzuka-chan's 
Trainer for you☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And the grand finale is...! Eeeek, I can't 
wait~☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Umm... what should I do...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Even if you say that—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Suzuka-chan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Giving it our all is the only way fans and 
Umadols can create the greatest stage 
together☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Umm... hmm... Even if you say that... 
L-Like this, maybe—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: S-S-Suzusuzusuzu~?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Flawless breathing and timing. I judge 
this to be a magnificent performance.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mm... Suzuka-chan! As an Umadol, I've 
overcome my hurdle...!

—All three are brimming with enthusiasm. 
We look forward to seeing what they'll 
achieve as Umadols!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... you know you can stop me, right...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Even if you tell me to do whatever I want, 
I don't know what to do... Um, well—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I-It's Silence Suzuka... Yaaay...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
................Um. I tried doing it the 
way I thought was best, but—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You look super great, Suzuka-chan! Cu~te! 
Prett~y! Love~ly!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Eh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see. So there are cases where showing 
some bashfulness is actually preferable. I 
shall keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I knew it...! Falco's eye for spotting 
Suzuka-chan's potential was spot on...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? ...Wait, what?

Silence Suzuka took a huge step forward as 
an Umadol...! Or so it felt!
